t.rel: It signed a peace treaty with Israel in 1994, and a large share of its population is of Palestinian origin. It has taken in many Syrian and Iraqi refugees and relies heavily on support from the United States and the Gulf states.
t.know: A large share of its citizens are of Palestinian origin.
t.etext: With few resources, it relies on services, exports of potash and phosphate, foreign aid and remittances. Water is extremely scarce, and it has taken in many refugees.
